title: 3iu | 3D Item Utils
description: Changing the utilities items from 2D into 3D modeled items
body:
## About
3iu is a small resourcepack that changes the old 2D model items into 3D model items for utilites.


<details>
<summary>Affected items</summary>

1.  Sword(1/7)
2.  Spear
3.  Axe
4.  Pickaxe
5.  Shovel
6.  Hoe
7.  Mace✅
8.  Trident✅

</details>

## Why should you download this project?
This resource pack is designed for players who want a more immersive and modern look for their Minecraft tools without changing the core vanilla aesthetic. By transforming flat 2D sprites into detailed 3D models, each utility item feels more substantial and "weighted" in your hand, especially when paired with the new 26.1 "Tiny Takeover" lighting and AO (Ambient Occlusion) updates. It provides a high-quality visual upgrade that makes combat and gathering feel more satisfying.

## 


<details>
<summary>Critical information before downloading</summary>

1. Version Compatibility: This resource pack is designed for 1.21.1+ (including 26.1). While it uses Format 61 for 1.21.4 compatibility, we recommend testing on your specific version if models appear incorrectly.

2. Performance: The models are optimized with low-poly counts to ensure there is no significant impact on FPS, even on lower-end systems.

3. No Optifine Required: These are native Java .json models and do not require any third-party shaders or CIT mods to function.
4. Visual Note: High-quality lighting (AO) is recommended in your game settings to see the full depth of the 3D models as intended.

</details>
